# LuauG API reference

Generated from the typed IDL in [`../../api/defs/`](../../api/defs/), which
is the same source the engine's C++ registration, the `.d.luau` type
definitions and the versioned api-dump come from. If a member is here, the
engine has it.

**This is the catalogue, not the design.**
[`../api-design.md`](../api-design.md) is where the reasoning lives —
why signals are deferred, why children are not members, what a `Content`
URN is — and [`../migrating.md`](../migrating.md) is the
guided tour.
